Mirroring the file would create a file apm-go never uses. Decision B (ticket 12): baseline exclusion, not mirrored.

Decision B (ticket 12): baseline exclusion, not mirrored.

The Oracle touches ~/.cache/apm/last_version_check (save_version_check_timestamp()) whenever check_for_updates() runs and should_check_for_updates() finds no cache file or one older than 86400s -- gated by _check_and_notify_updates() in the CLI's post-command callback (cli.py:178), so it appears on commands that reach that callback (e.g. doctor) but not on --version/--help, which exit before it runs. apm-go has no self-update/version-check feature: no code path calls GitHub to compare versions or persists a check timestamp. Decision B (ticket 12): baseline exclusion, not mirrored.

Verified this is NOT apm_cli's own application code: grepped every marketplace/*.py file for a gh/subprocess/git-credential-helper call and found none. Reproduced directly outside the parity runner too: a bare `uv run --project <oracle> apm pack -m claude --dry-run` (no --check-versions/--check-clean at all) against a fresh HOME also creates ~/.local/state/gh/device-id -- confirming this is a side effect of `uv run` itself (the parity harness's own Oracle-invocation wrapper, main.go's defaultOracleCmd), most likely `uv`'s own dependency/interpreter resolution touching a git-credential-helper path on this machine, not the Oracle CLI's own behavior a real installed `apm` binary would ever exhibit. apm-go has no uv-equivalent wrapper and no gh CLI dependency at all, so it can never produce this path regardless of how faithfully it ports the Oracle's own command behavior. Decision B (ticket 12's own precedent): baseline exclusion, not mirrored.
